whoItsFor: Security defenders, researchers, and authorized penetration testers who want to study or validate LLM-driven autonomous pentesting, either on systems they own or in explicitly permitted local isolated labs such as OWASP Juice Shop or DVWA.
useCases: Running autonomous recon-to-exploitation pentest jobs against owned or explicitly authorized targets
Steering an autonomous attack run by giving hints or intervening in the conversation
Studying autonomous AI attack behavior to build detection signatures and hardening checklists

requirements.runtime: Docker, Docker Compose (source build also needs Go and Node.js)
